paragraphs.text: Roxi is a human employee and the public relations officer of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Roxi deals with the public relations of the park. Her job is to give a generous interpretation of the goings-on of the park spinning its dangers as excitement. She is the self-titled "Publicist to the Stars."
Roxi is responsible for the massive amount of park flyers air-dropped on planets.
